registeredRepair.priorRepair: v13 produced 320/320 canonical, eligible, fault-free matches and cleared all sheet-level and motion-choice gates, but failed the handling/class dominance gates
registeredRepair.decisionTiming: after the complete v13 dominance read and before any v14 match outcome
registeredRepair.observedInvalidation: Deliberate-heavy compositions won 26.67% versus 55.93% for other compositions. The stock mind blocked off-cone aim preparation after both route rotation and route movement, so a facing-locked body that kept patrolling could repeatedly move without ever taking the promised next-tick aim preparation. Minesmith appeared only in five already-strong sheets and had an 80% correlated fielded win rate; no class statistic is changed from that confounded read
registeredRepair.change: retain the one-tick commitment after a route-facing rotation, but let a facing-locked body prepare an otherwise legal visible shot on the tick after movement. Swift and Standard retain the v13 route/aim commitment. Rules, class stats, sheets, samples, and gates remain frozen
